Given a graph $\mathcal{G}=(V,E)$ and a feature matrix $X$, our encoder computes node representations via message passing. The update rule of layer $l$ is defined as $h_v^{(l+1)} = \sigma(W^{(l)} \cdot \textsc{AGG}(\{h_u^{(l)} : u \in \mathcal{N}(v)\}))$, where $\mathcal{N}(v)$ denotes the neighborhood of node $v$.\footnote{We omit bias terms for clarity.} We train the model end-to-end and evaluate it on four datasets.
